intent: K0 of the refactor and clean-up programme: put the review's 110 operator decisions where they can be ruled. The register is rendered from the verification run that re-checked every one of them read-only against ce4ac1fd, with each option's consequence, a recommendation and a ruling line; the eight questions it groups them into are raised in the repository's own decision queue. Nothing marked OP is acted on until it carries a ruling.

reasons.evidence: the register is 3,165 generated lines, over the express limit of 100; no source file, no protected path and no sensitive path is touched

claims: tests/unit/c8-the-programme-is-closed.test.ts (claimed by the ORACLE lane, not by this session)
programme: K0 of the refactor and clean-up programme (K0 to K19), which follows org/plans/2026-09-consolidation.md. The plan itself is filed at Phase 2, after the full review; this batch only records what the operator must rule before any of it is acted on.
invariants: I1 NOTHING OP IS ACTED ON WITHOUT ITS RULING. Every one of the review's 110 operator-decision findings has a disposition in the register: an entry with a ruling line, or a recorded return to the executor's free band with its reason. The oracle fails if one is silent.
I2 A RECOMMENDATION IS NOT A RULING. Every entry carries a ruling line; the oracle checks the line exists, never its wording, so it holds equally before and after the operator answers.
I3 THE QUESTIONS ARE WHERE THE REPOSITORY KEEPS THEM. The eight batched questions are entries in org/QUESTIONS.md, the queue org/START.md names, and a folded one carries its answer.
I4 NO FINDING IS RE-PROPOSED THAT THE REVIEW REFUTED. The eight refuted findings and the five marked leave-as-is carry no entry.
